title: [Network pharmacology and experimental validation reveal therapeutic mechanism of Yuyang Jianpi Pills for gastric ulcer with spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome by inhibiting inflammation and apoptosis via IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 pathway].
authors: Yuan, Xue-Ling; Liu, Peng-Peng; Zuo, Jiao-Jiao; Dou, Peng-Cheng; Mao, Cheng-Dan; Kang, Li; Song, Rui-Ping; Shu, Jin
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药治疗胃溃疡的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and animal experiments to investigate the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of Yuyang Jianpi Pills for gastric ulcer(GU) in rats modeled with spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome. Active ingredients and targets of Yuyang Jianpi Pills were searched against TCMSP, BATMAN-TCM, SwissTargetPrediction, and relevant literature. The targets associated with GU and spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome were screened from the GeneCards database and the TCMIP platform. The common targets shared by Yuyang Jianpi Pills and GU were identified as core therapeutic targets. Subsequent analyses included protein-protein interaction(PPI) network construction, Gene Ontology(GO) functional annotation, and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG) pathway enrichment. Molecular docking was performed to validate the binding interactions between key active ingredients and core targets. Male SPF-grade SD rats were randomized into a sham-operated group(8 rats) and a model group(52 rats). The GU model with spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome in rats was established by a combination of bitter-cold purgation, irregular feeding, and direct acetic acid cauterization. After the model was successfully established, the rats were randomly allocated into model, omeprazole(3.6 mg.kg~(-1).d~(-1)), and high-, medium-, low-dose(2.2, 1.1, 0.55 g.kg~(-1).d~(-1), respectively) Yuyang Jianpi Pills groups(n=8). The drugs were administered continuously for 2 weeks. Food intake, body weight, rectal temperature, and symptoms of spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome were monitored to evaluate modeling success and treatment efficacy. After gastric tissue collection, the pathological changes in the tissue were observed via hematoxylin-eosin(HE) staining. The enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay(ELISA) was used to quantify the levels of interleukin(IL)-17, prostaglandin E2(PGE2), and pepsin content. Western blot was employed to determine the expression levels of factors in the IL-6/janus kinase 2(JAK2)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3(STAT3) signaling pathway, as well as B-cell lymphoma-2(Bcl-2), Bcl-2-associated X protein(Bax), and cleaved cysteinyl aspartate-specific proteinase 3(cleaved caspase-3). immunohistochemical assay was adopted to detect the expression levels of IL-6, phosphorylated(p)-JAK2, and p-STAT3 in gastric mucosa. Gastric mucosal cell apoptosis was detected by terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase mediated dUTP nick end labeling(TUNEL) assay. A total of 1 094 drug targets and 1 104 disease targets were screened out, with an intersection of 205 core targets. The PPI, GO and KEGG enrichment analyses, and molecular docking indicated that the therapeutic mechanism of Yuyang Jianpi Pills for GU with spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome was closely related to the IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, inflammation, and apoptosis. The results of animal experiments confirmed that during modeling, compared with the sham group, the model group exhibited significantly decreased food intake, and rectal temperature, along with slower body mass growth and pronounced symptoms of spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome. After administration, compared with the model group, the high-and medium-dose Yuyang Jianpi Pills groups showed significant increases in food intake, body mass, and rectal temperature, along with significant alleviation of spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome symptoms. Each treatment group showed alleviated pathological damage of the gastric mucosa to varying degrees, declined levels of IL-17 and pepsin in the gastric tissue, elevated levels of PGE2, and down-regulated protein levels of IL-6, p-JAK2, and p-STAT3 in the gastric mucosa. TUNEL staining showed that the treatments reduced gastric mucosal cell apoptosis, down-regulated the protein levels of Bax and cleaved caspase-3 in the gastric tissue, while up-regulating the expression of Bcl-2. These findings demonstrate that Yuyang Jianpi Pills effectively treats GU in rats with spleen-stomach deficiency-cold syndrome, potentially through regulating the IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, thereby suppressing gastric mucosal inflammation and inhibiting cell apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 本研究整合网络药理学、分子对接和动物实验，探讨愈疡健脾丸对脾虚寒证大鼠胃溃疡（GU）的治疗效果及机制。通过TCMSP、BATMAN-TCM、SwissTargetPrediction及相关文献检索愈疡健脾丸的活性成分和靶点。从GeneCards数据库和TCMIP平台筛选与GU及脾虚寒证相关的靶点。将愈疡健脾丸与GU共有的靶点确定为核心治疗靶点。后续分析包括蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络构建、基因本体（GO）功能注释和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集。通过分子对接验证关键活性成分与核心靶点之间的结合相互作用。雄性SPF级SD大鼠随机分为假手术组（8只）和模型组（52只）。通过苦寒泻下、饮食不节和乙酸直接灼烧相结合的方法建立脾虚寒证GU大鼠模型。模型成功建立后，将大鼠随机分为模型组、奥美拉唑组（3.6 mg.kg~(-1).d~(-1)）以及愈疡健脾丸高、中、低剂量组（分别为2.2、1.1、0.55 g.kg~(-1).d~(-1)）（n=8）。连续给药2周。监测摄食量、体重、直肠温度及脾虚寒证症状，以评估造模成功和治疗效果。采集胃组织后，通过苏木精-伊红（HE）染色观察组织病理变化。采用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）定量白细胞介素（IL）-17、前列腺素E2（PGE2）和胃蛋白酶含量。采用Western blot检测IL-6/Janus激酶2（JAK2）/信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）信号通路因子及B细胞淋巴瘤-2（Bcl-2）、Bcl-2相关X蛋白（Bax）和裂解型半胱氨酸天冬氨酸特异性蛋白酶3（cleaved caspase-3）的表达水平。采用免疫组织化学法检测胃黏膜中IL-6、磷酸化（p）-JAK2和p-STAT3的表达水平。通过末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶介导的dUTP缺口末端标记（TUNEL）法检测胃黏膜细胞凋亡。共筛选出1 094个药物靶点和1 104个疾病靶点，交集为205个核心靶点。PPI、GO和KEGG富集分析及分子对接表明，愈疡健脾丸治疗脾虚寒证GU的机制与IL-6/JAK2/STAT3信号通路、炎症和凋亡密切相关。动物实验结果证实，造模期间，与假手术组相比，模型组摄食量和直肠温度显著降低，体重增长缓慢，脾虚寒证症状明显。给药后，与模型组相比，愈疡健脾丸高、中剂量组摄食量、体重和直肠温度显著增加，脾虚寒证症状显著缓解。各治疗组胃黏膜病理损伤均有不同程度减轻，胃组织中IL-17和胃蛋白酶水平下降，PGE2水平升高，胃黏膜中IL-6、p-JAK2和p-STAT3蛋白水平下调。TUNEL染色显示，治疗减少了胃黏膜细胞凋亡，下调胃组织中Bax和cleaved caspase-3蛋白水平，同时上调Bcl-2表达。这些发现表明，愈疡健脾丸有效治疗脾虚寒证GU大鼠，可能通过调节IL-6/JAK2/STAT3信号通路，从而抑制胃黏膜炎症和细胞凋亡。
